meta.title: quality-gates roadmap — the repo dogfooding its own audit plugin

buildCommands.selftests: for f in plugins/audit/hooks/_config.py plugins/audit/hooks/require-plan.py plugins/audit/hooks/guard-edits.py plugins/audit/hooks/guard-secrets-read.py plugins/audit/hooks/remind-tdd.py plugins/audit/scripts/validate-manifest.py; do python3 "$f" --selftest || exit 1; done
buildCommands.plugin-validate: claude plugin validate . && claude plugin validate plugins/audit

phases.title: v0.3.0 hardening
phases.desiredOutcome: Every correctness defect confirmed by the v0.2.0 deep review is fixed: resume works, run is guarded, the bypass is transactional, guards fail loud without an interpreter, dead config surface is gone, and the validator catches cycles and broken links.
phases.summary: Shipped as eight direct-to-main commits, tagged v0.3.0. All 129 (now 133) selftest cases green; legacy-manifest fixture proves schema back-compat; claude plugin validate passes. Work predates this dogfood manifest, hence no phase branch.

tasks.title: Config integrity: _configError marker + deep-copied defaults
tasks.description: Malformed audit.config.json silently fell back to defaults, deactivating custom secret patterns/rules with zero signal. Mark present-but-broken configs, surface once per session, deep-copy DEFAULTS, add _config selftest.

outcome.technical: load() distinguishes absent vs malformed; detect-plan-skip emits one systemMessage per session; 6 selftest cases.
outcome.descriptive: A broken config now announces itself instead of silently dropping protections.

tasks.title: py-launch.sh interpreter fallback + 10s timeouts + NotebookEdit gating
tasks.description: All hooks invoked python3 directly; exit 127 (no such interpreter — typical Windows) was a non-blocking error, so every guard silently failed OPEN. Launch via POSIX-sh launcher resolving python3->python->py; guards emit permissionDecision ask when nothing resolves; add explicit 10s timeouts; gate NotebookEdit.

outcome.technical: Builtins-only sh launcher, exec passes stdin once; ask/open fail modes hardcoded in hooks.json (config needs python — chicken-and-egg).
outcome.descriptive: Guards now fail LOUD instead of silently vanishing on machines without python3.

tasks.title: Transactional plan-bypass + change-magnitude gate
tasks.description: PreToolUse consumed the single-use #no-plan bypass and burned the free-file slot even when a sibling hook or the user denied the edit. Split: Pre observes, Post (fires only after a successful edit) consumes/records. Replace added-line count with magnitude = max(lines, chars/200, removed) closing the minified-blob and mass-deletion loopholes.

outcome.technical: decide() gains event param; PostToolUse registration in hooks.json; selftest rewritten (21 cases).
outcome.descriptive: A denied edit no longer eats your bypass; size tricks no longer pass as trivial.

tasks.title: Secret-guard indirect reads + shell source-write block + self-edit protection
tasks.description: Close verified bypasses: git show HEAD:.env, source .env, cp/mv of secrets; sed -i / tee / >-redirect writes into source files (plan-first backstop, in_progress-covered files exempt); deny edits of the installed plugin dir (dev checkout exempt) and plan-bypass-* forgery.

outcome.technical: Read verbs extended; redirect/tee/sed target extraction; source exts derive from tddReminder.sourceGlobs; 48+12 selftest cases.
outcome.descriptive: The obvious side doors around the secret and plan gates are shut.

tasks.title: Validator upgrades + schema cleanup
tasks.description: Add dependency-cycle detection (incl. task-blocked-by-own-phase deadlock), reciprocal bug<->task checks, bidirectional fileIndex, tests-not-object finding, unknown-key warnings with did-you-mean, exit codes 0/1/2. Schema: canonical $id, BUG-id pattern, remove 8 never-read meta fields (legacy manifests keep validating).

add: A<->B dependsOn cycle is a finding
non-reciprocal bug link is a finding

outcome.technical: Iterative 3-color DFS over the waits-on graph; 29 selftest cases; ajv green on starter and legacy fixture.
outcome.descriptive: The validator now catches deadlocks and broken links before the orchestrator hits them.

tasks.title: Orchestrator: resume, run guards, infra-failure, no-ff fallback, preflight, desiredOutcome
tasks.description: Resume searched for phase.status == in_progress which nothing ever wrote — write it at phase entry, add the resume subcommand with a pre-0.3 fallback. Guard run (done/blocked/in_progress). Split test failure from infrastructure failure (no attempts burned). Offer --no-ff when ff-merge fails. Unconditional high-risk confirm. Preflight for config/manifest/usage. Wire desiredOutcome end-to-end.

outcome.technical: Full audit.md revision; AskUserQuestion added to allowed-tools; init generates desiredOutcome per phase.
outcome.descriptive: The headline promises — resumable, safe re-runs, team-repo merges — now hold.

tasks.title: Quote YAML frontmatter in all four commands
tasks.description: claude plugin validate revealed audit.md's unquoted description (contains ': ') failed YAML parsing — ALL its frontmatter, allowed-tools included, was silently dropped at runtime since v0.2.0; init.md's argument-hint parsed as a YAML array. Quote every frontmatter value.

outcome.technical: Single-quoted YAML scalars across the four command files; claude plugin validate passes clean.
outcome.descriptive: Command metadata actually applies at runtime now.

tasks.title: Release v0.3.0: bump + annotated tag on one commit
tasks.description: Bump plugin.json to 0.3.0, add the marketplace description flagged by claude plugin validate, tag v0.3.0 on the same commit so the tagged tree and main agree (unlike v0.2.0).

outcome.technical: git show v0.3.0 confirms version 0.3.0 + marketplace name quality-gates.
outcome.descriptive: First release where the tag and the shipped tree tell the same story.

phases.title: v0.4.0 release quality
phases.desiredOutcome: A stranger can trust and adopt the plugin: CI proves every guard on two platforms, docs are runnable and warn about global hooks, policies (SECURITY/CONTRIBUTING/CHANGELOG) exist, hooks speak the canonical protocol, and the repo dogfoods its own manifest.
phases.summary: Six content commits + this manifest + the release commit, tagged v0.4.0. CI runs the full battery on ubuntu and windows; this file is itself a CI fixture.

tasks.title: Canonical JSON permissionDecision deny for blocking guards
tasks.description: Replace the deprecated exit-2 + stderr blocking channel (indistinguishable from a hook crash) with hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision deny + reason on stdout, exit 0. Decision cores untouched.

add: each selftest asserts the deny payload shape

outcome.technical: _deny_payload() helper per guard; 133 selftest cases total.
outcome.descriptive: Blocks are now explicit protocol, not an ambiguous exit code.

tasks.title: CHANGELOG backfill + SECURITY threat model + CONTRIBUTING
tasks.description: Keep-a-Changelog 0.1.0-0.4.0 incl. the v0.2.0 tag/main mismatch note (fixed forward, tags never moved); guardrails-not-jails threat model with per-hook fail-mode table and seven accepted bypass classes; dev setup, test matrix, one-commit release rule, commands-vs-skills NO-GO decision record.

outcome.descriptive: The policy envelope a team needs before trusting an enforcement plugin.

tasks.title: Root README + plugin README overhaul
tasks.description: Repo landing page (GitHub showed the internal build guide); plugin README gains Requirements, runnable snippets (no more unresolvable <plugin> placeholder), the 'installing arms global hooks' warning with scoping/disable/uninstall, repos-without-tests guidance, and a one-session-per-clone note.

outcome.technical: Full rewrite of plugins/audit/README.md; new root README.md.
outcome.descriptive: Onboarding no longer requires reading the source.

tasks.title: PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE sync to 0.3/0.4 reality
tasks.description: Fix 'four guard hooks' (five), the stale claude-plugins rename note (marketplace is quality-gates), and every per-file section that predated the hardening; add launcher/CI/dogfood to the tree and verify sections.

outcome.technical: Guide again matches the code it documents.
outcome.descriptive: The self-sufficient build guide is true again.

tasks.title: CI: selftests + validators on ubuntu/windows
tasks.description: Three jobs: six selftest suites + launcher checks (interpreter resolution, fail-loud ask JSON, canonical deny JSON) on both OSes; the plugin's own validator + ajv over starter and this manifest; claude plugin validate for marketplace + plugin.

add: windows leg proves the python3->python->py fallback

outcome.technical: All steps simulated locally before commit.
outcome.descriptive: A hook regression can no longer ship silently.

tasks.title: Plugin metadata: repository, category, tags, strict
tasks.description: Add the professional-listing fields claude plugin validate and marketplaces surface.

outcome.technical: claude plugin validate passes for both manifests.

tasks.title: Dogfood manifest: this roadmap as an audit manifest
tasks.description: Write the repo's own roadmap (P1 shipped, P2 this release, P3 planned) as a manifest the plugin's validator + ajv verify in CI — a permanent integration fixture, a real-world example, and a reciprocal BUG-1<->P1.7 link exercising the new validator checks.

outcome.technical: Generated programmatically (fileIndex derived from tasks); commit SHA rides the release commit per the manifest's own ride-along convention.
outcome.descriptive: The plugin eats its own dog food in CI.

phases.title: v0.5.0 features (ADO-team focus)
phases.desiredOutcome: The pipeline plugs into the team's Azure DevOps workflow: bugs/tasks sync to work items, CI can gate on manifest state, status renders as a shareable report, and two sessions cannot corrupt one manifest.

tasks.title: Azure DevOps work-item sync (/audit:sync push|pull|status)
tasks.description: Contract = az boards CLI (headless-capable in ADO Pipelines); MCP wit_* tools documented as an optional fast-path. Config meta.ado {organization, project, areaPath?, types}; bugs<->Bug and tasks<->Task mapping; additive write-back fields bug.ado/task.ado {id,url,lastSyncedAt}; push idempotent (diff before write), one direction per invocation, no background magic.

add: round-trip against a scratch ADO project
manifest revalidates after every sync write

tasks.title: CI headless gate (scripts/audit-status.py --json|--gate)
tasks.description: Machine-readable phase/task/bug rollup; --gate exits 1 on open high-severity bugs / blocked tasks / invalid manifest (reuses validate-manifest as a library). Ship an azure-pipelines.yml example and wire into this repo's CI against this manifest.

add: pipeline fails on a fixture with an open high-sev bug

tasks.title: /audit report (scripts/render-report.py)
tasks.description: Manifest -> self-contained HTML + Markdown (phase progress, task table, bug rollup, ADO links from the ado fields); publishable as an ADO pipeline artifact. report subcommand runs it and prints the artifact path.

add: output opens with zero network fetches

tasks.title: Concurrency lock (<manifestPath>.lock)
tasks.description: Acquire {sessionId, hostname, startedAt} lock around mutating subcommands (next|run|phase|review|resume); refuse with holder info on conflict; stale >60min offers a confirmed takeover; status/report never lock; require-plan exempts the lockfile.

bugs.title: audit.md YAML frontmatter silently dropped at runtime
bugs.description: audit.md's frontmatter description contained ': ' unquoted, so YAML parsing failed and Claude Code loaded the command with EMPTY metadata — description, argument-hint and allowed-tools never applied, since v0.2.0. init.md's argument-hint parsed as a YAML array instead of a string.
repro: observe: 'YAML frontmatter failed to parse ... loads with empty metadata'
bugs.expected: All four commands load with their declared metadata.
bugs.actual: audit.md loaded with empty metadata; init.md argument-hint was an array.
bugs.notes: Found by adopting claude plugin validate as a release gate; the gate is now enforced in CI.
